## Why

D4-verify-merged-2026-09-29T04 found that #993 (merge `209f989b024d`) includes fork read-only Gate handling and `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`, but lacks an executed deliberate-break/revert transcript with literal pytest output.

Unmet: deliberate-break transcript disabling fork fallback is not in the squash diff.

## Scope

Add durable current-main RED/GREEN evidence for the fork Gate fallback merged by #993. Do not change production behavior.

## Non-Goals

Do not remove or alter the fork tolerance behavior landed in #993. Do not broaden the Gate campaign or modify unrelated workflow logic.

## Tasks

- [ ] Test a deliberate-break mutation disabling fork fallback on a branch off main with `python -m pytest --no-cov tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q`, and capture literal FAIL output.
- [ ] Update `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` to exactly restore production behavior, rerun the named pytest gate, and capture literal PASS output.
- [ ] Add RED/GREEN command transcripts under `docs/evidence` and link them from the closing PR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With only the fork read-only fallback deliberately disabled, `python -m pytest --no-cov tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q` exits nonzero and names fork or deleted-fork failures; the evidence document records the literal command and output.
- [ ] After exact restoration, `python -m pytest --no-cov tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q` exits 0; the evidence document records the literal command and output.
- [ ] `git diff --exit-code -- .github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` exits 0 after restoration.
- [ ] `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` exits 0 and the closing PR links #994.

## Implementation Notes

Use the production test harness landed by #993. Record a fresh current-main replay, not reconstructed historical #993 output.
